intro.narration: [excited] Heey — what is eighty-eight percent of seventy-five? [pause] Watch this.

steps.narration: [curious] That one looks awkward. [pause] It really isn't.
[confident] Just swap the two numbers. [pause] A percent of B is the same as B percent of A.
steps.working: a% of b = b% of a

steps.narration: [confident] So do the easy side. Three quarters of eighty-eight.
[excited] Sixty-six. [pause] Same answer, far less work.
[thoughtful] Careful — this works for percent of, never percent off. [pause] Eighty-eight percent off seventy-five leaves nine. Flipped, it leaves twenty-two.

tts.tool: core/tools/elevenlabs.mjs say() — cached by hash of (text, voice, model, settings); durations measured with ffprobe and used verbatim
tts.driver_note: That module's CLI guard `import.meta.url === file://${process.argv[1]}` never matches on Windows, so the CLI prints nothing. say() was imported directly from the same module by <run>/tts.mjs with the lines in <run>/lines.json. No HTTP was hand-rolled and no credential appears in argv, output or any artifact.
